anilist.description:
At the mysterious orphanage where Sheena lives, death is nothing new to its residents—girls who no longer have families of their own, who are raised as weapons of war, taught to kill and take the lives of others without batting an eye. Everyone, that is, except Sheena, who wishes for nothing more than the growing conflict around her to end. On the night of her roommate's death, Sheena meets a strange girl covered in blood, who smiles despite the turmoil surrounding them. The next day, the girl appears as a new student in Sheena's class and introduces herself as Mimi. Initially thought to be a school myth, there are now whispers in the orphanage's halls that Mimi is their secret weapon—an immortal who cannot die. When Mimi is later assigned as Sheena's new roommate, Sheena's world grows even more complicated when she begins living with someone who loves and welcomes death, when all Sheena wants to do is stop it…

(Source: Kodansha USA)

episodes.title: The Kiss
episodes.overview: Sheena is an orphan who is trained for war, even though she doesn't want to be. And one day, she meets Mimi.

episodes.title: It Does Hurt
episodes.overview: Sheena, Mimi, and their classmates get sent into the forest to fight 100 magical enemies in a combat exercise.

episodes.title: Friends
episodes.overview: After Sheena realizes she wants to make friends with Mimi, Mimi decides to share an important secret with her.

episodes.title: Accomplices
episodes.overview: Sheena tries to learn more about Mimi's condition but is confronted by Ms. Fran and sworn to absolute secrecy.

episodes.title: Endless Night
episodes.overview: Sheena struggles to understand Mimi's mysterious curse and her seemingly nonchalant attitude toward the war.

episodes.title: Welcome Home
episodes.overview: The war escalates. When Mimi isn't enough, the school makes a drastic decision.

episodes.title: Not Afraid Anymore
episodes.overview: Despite struggling somewhat during her combat test against Mimi, Seiran volunteers to go into actual battle.

episodes.title: I`m Back
episodes.overview: Ari struggles to process the material and emotional consequences of Seiran's brief tenure on the battlefield.

episodes.title: My Magic
episodes.overview: Sheena visits Ms. Fran for advice on how to use her magical abilities to better help the school and her peers.

episodes.title: An Unforgettable Day
episodes.overview: As Sheena keeps working to improve her magic, she and Mimi get acquainted with a somewhat reclusive classmate.

episodes.title: Untarnished
episodes.overview: Mimi keeps getting called to battle, but Sheena is relieved that she keeps coming home practically untouched.

episodes.title: As I Am
episodes.overview: Sheena and Mimi search for a way to come to an understanding and reaffirm their friendship after an argument.
